title: Grant request answer
description: Either the open request (with `replayed: true` when one already stood) or `{ held: true }` when the caller already holds the board or container. `region` is left out for a board.

request.description: The `seq` of the grant request; the person's answer names it

board.description: The board the request is for.

region.description: The container the request is for; left out for the whole board.

replayed.description: True when you already had this request open, so nothing new was recorded.

board.description: The board you hold, or the board the container is on.

region.description: The container you already hold; left out for the whole board.

held.description: True: you already hold this board or container, so no request was recorded.
